digest.component_or_area: CI workflow and pytest test routing
propositions: Nineteen OS/Python-invariant repository-policy assertions are redundantly executed across all four default-suite matrix cells (Ubuntu 3.11/3.12/3.13 and macOS 3.13) despite their inputs and assertions being immutable repository text/AST.

The 19 inventoried nodes must be marked with a strict repo_policy pytest marker at function level and routed to run only once in the Ubuntu 3.13 default-suite process while being excluded from the other three default matrix cells.

The shared workflow default selector must be modified to append `and not repo_policy` to the selector for non-primary cells (Ubuntu 3.11/3.12 and macOS 3.13) while keeping repo_policy nodes in the Ubuntu 3.13 cell.
All unmarked behavior and runtime/subprocess tests in the seven mixed modules must retain their original default selection without change.
The CI workflow parity tests must verify exact 19-node inventory collection, mark/non-mark partitioning of mixed modules, matrix integrity, and unchanged integration routing.
